_about: What each agent can really do and how to prompt it. Built from the registry (run argv / flags), the code (realadapters, agentic, tools) and observed run history. Values marked 'unknown' or 'unverified' were not proven. data/agent_profiles.json (same shape) overrides any field. Live availability, cooldowns and success rates are merged in at prompt time (agency/profiles.py). Each agent's "prompt" block (how_run, step/plan/review, length) is put in front of its step, plan and review prompts by realadapters.guided(); passes/json_mode document how the prompt reaches it.

claude-code.can_read_files: only the files pasted into the prompt
claude-code.prompt_tips: Give the goal, the exact files (complete text) and the check; ask for ONE JSON patch. Strongest planner and reviewer; spend it on the hard parts.
known_failures: unrecognized_model for a malformed local-variant model name; fixed by the variant-naming change

prompt.how_run: `claude -p` with every tool switched off (--tools ""); the prompt arrives on stdin. You cannot open files, run commands or browse: everything you can use is in this prompt. Your reply (stdout) is parsed as the JSON object.
prompt.json_mode: none used (the CLI has --json-schema / --output-format json; not adopted: unverified with these task schemas, the reply is parsed tolerantly instead)
prompt.step: Give every changed file COMPLETE (never '...', 'rest unchanged' or a diff); for a text job give the whole result in "answer". If you truly cannot do it, reply with no files and notes that say plainly why you cannot (that is not counted against you).
prompt.plan: Each objective is all its agent sees besides the goal: make it complete and self-contained (files, the exact change or result, how it is checked).
prompt.review: Approve only what you could see and verify. Every reason must name the file, the line or part, what is wrong and what to change: your reasons are passed word for word to the agent that fixes the work.
prompt.length: As long as the task needs; your output limit is large. Do not think out loud in the reply.

prompt.json_mode: n/a (final message is the answer; files are read from the container's /work)
prompt.step: Make the change in /work and run the acceptance check until it exits 0; never edit or delete the check or the tests to make it pass (that is detected and reverted). prompt.length: Keep your final message short for a code job (what you changed, the check result); for a text job the final message is the complete answer.
